flags.reason: The Product Merchandising Card guide (3f56271) and its evidence were checked on 20 October 2026 on the c7d3348 build; the installed v0.1.78-dbe0e02 has a different ProductMerchandisingCard.tsx (9e4e6ac at c7d3348, 660c1b0 at dbe0e02), changed by Biscuit's ace46ca and dbe0e02 for Component Bug #356, and the evidence's 28 October note says the guide's copy waits for #356's own publish. Read against the installed source, these sentences no longer hold, and the entry leaves them out: (1) Anatomy's Footer note “A blurred copy of the photo behind the text; no dark shade.”: a 65 px gradient from transparent to black now sits over the blur (ProductMerchandisingCard.tsx lines 331–399). (2) Configuration's “badge, avatar, specialBadge, and cta replace those parts and don’t get the card’s modes.” and the Badge icons caption “An Icon before each label; the card doesn’t colour it.”: the slots are cloned with the card's modes (45–58, 235–297), and a default Icon in badgeIcon is purple, rgb(93, 0, 181), and white in specialBadgeIcon. (3) The Badge Size Small caption “Smaller badges.”: the glass badge is pinned to Badge Size Medium (224–233, 505–513), so only the corner badge gets smaller. (4) Do & Don'ts: “White text needs a photo behind it.” and “The card has no background, so its white title disappears.”: without imageSource the card draws a #141414 surface (318–324, 377–379); “A stranger’s stock photo appears.”: without avatarSource the avatar is a monogram of avatarMonogram or else the title's first letter (248–262), and the page rendered on this build already shows “S” in that Don't; and the description's “loses its text, shows a stranger”. (5) Sources: “… and has no gradient”, “Figma darkens the footer with a black gradient, while the package draws only a blurred copy of the photo, so the white text sits on a pale haze, with a lighter band where the copy is re-cropped.”, “Badge icons and the badge, avatar, specialBadge, and cta slots don’t get the card’s modes.” and “Without avatarSource or avatarMonogram the avatar is a stock portrait, and without imageSource the card has no background.” The guide is updated when Component Bug #356 publishes (the Component Fix flow updates the guide copy a fix changed; the sentences are listed in a note on #356), then a new Agent pack ticket re-extracts. Added by Claude Code in the overnight run agentpack-r25, for Marcin to confirm. Component Bug #356.
